source: loading.dev 0.3.8 by Jakub Krehel and Paul Faivret (MIT), github.com/jakubkrehel/loading
how: Paste the file as it is. It takes the colour of the text around it (currentColor) and its size from --ld-size (1.25em when not set, 20px in 16px text). --ld-duration changes its speed. Hidden from screen readers: put the words (Loading…) beside it.
